section_summary.extract_value: This section describes translation and back-translation procedures for the BAS-2 and a study to assess item and score equivalence in a bilingual group of English Studies Master's degree students (53 women, 17 men). Data were collected in January–February 2017 via anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaires administered by research assistants; correlations between English and Polish item scores ranged .69–.90 and Pearson's correlation between total scores was .95. The section also notes that the first subsample completed only the BAS-2 while the second subsample completed all measures.

Pearson's correlation between total scores was .95.'
